title: CI: launcher registration fixtures compare an 8.3 short-name temp path with the long canonical path (RUNNER~1 vs runneradmin)
outcome: CI: launcher registration fixtures compare an 8.3 short-name temp path with the long canonical path (RUNNER~1 vs runneradmin)
acceptance: Registration query and worker-receipt identity checks accept equivalent existing Windows 8.3/long-name paths and directory aliases, while retaining the exact run, owner, request-digest, contract and durable-acknowledgement requirements; missing, inaccessible or genuinely different paths fail before execution.

Fail-first controls exercise genuinely different spellings of the same existing directory at the host query and worker-receipt boundaries — a Windows 8.3 short-name witness wherever the test volume provides short names, with any skip stated in the test output rather than passing silently, and a directory junction or symlink alias — and preserve the foreground/detached ACK hold, no preflight before ACK, single registration and single execution assertions; distinct and unavailable-path negatives remain refused.
The maintained full five-stage gate passes on the exact final input, and the independent review pair has no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
The relevant GitHub CI launcher tests pass on Windows and macOS on the landed commit.
